podcast.title: Elementary School Formation
podcast.body: Jacob Danger Armstrong formed Mount Eddie with a group of friends he knew from elementary school. "performing in a band called Mount Eddie, which he for with a bunch of friends from elementary school."

podcast.title: Four-Piece Band
podcast.body: Ultra Q is a four-piece band, led by Jacob Danger Armstrong. "There are four pieces led by a guy named Jacob Danger Armstrong."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Musical Offspring
podcast.body: Jacob Danger Armstrong was born on September 12th, 1998, and is the son of Billy Joe Armstrong. His middle name is "Danger." He played bass temporarily for his older brother Joey's band, Emily's Army, before forming his own band called St. Eddie. "Another song, Jacob Danger Armstrong. Yeah, his middle name is Danger. Came along on September 12th of 1998...including the temporary appearance of little brother Jacob Armstrong on bass. Well, Jacob went off with his own band called St. Eddie."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Name Origin
podcast.body: The band Ultra Q is named after a Japanese sci-fi series. "Ultra Q who was named after a Japanese sci-fi series."

podcast.title: Son of Billie Joe Armstrong
podcast.body: Jacob Danger Armstrong is the younger brother of Joey Armstrong and the second son of Green Day's Billie Joe Armstrong, following in his father's musical footsteps. "Jacob Danger Armstrong that's Joey's younger brother in Billy Joe's second son."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Billy Joe Armstrong's Enduring Marriage and Family Support
xref.body: Billy Joe Armstrong's marriage to his wife, Adrian, has lasted. Adrian, originally from Minnesota, holds a degree in sociology and works for a company that produces merchandise for punk bands. She frequently tours with Green Day, while Billy Joe's mother (affectionately called Grandma), the former waitress from Rod's Hickory Pit, looks after their children, Joey and Jacob Danger Armstrong. "Only Billy Joe's marriage to his wife, Adrian, has survived. She's originally from Minnesota and has a degree in sociology. She also works for a company that manufactures merchandise for punk band stuff like t-shirts and posters."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Musical Offspring
xref.body: Billy Joe Armstrong has two sons, Joseph Marciano Armstrong (Joey), born February 28th, 1995, and named after Joey Ramone, and Jacob Danger Armstrong, born September 12th, 1998. Both sons have followed their father into music. "And on February 28th, 1995, Joseph Marciano Armstrong came into the world. He's called Joey after Joey Ramon. Another song, Jacob Danger Armstrong. Yeah, his middle name is Danger. Came along on September 12th of 1998. Both boys took after their father."
